scope: Deep review of uncommitted forms/card-link changes against git HEAD. Separate source corroboration from software checks; uncertainty is resolved conservatively by retaining or restoring original content. Not a claim of absolute certainty.

nounSpecialCases.finding: Presidenta is the recommended feminine; retain the table.
Actriz belongs to the performer sense; actora to other senses. Retain the scoped table.
Jefa and la jefe are valid; jefa is more frequent.
La líder and lideresa are supported; the latter is more common in America.
La cliente and clienta are both valid.
La juez and jueza are both valid.
La poeta and poetisa are both valid.
Alcaldesa is the feminine for the municipal office.
Masculine miembro may refer to women; common-gender la miembro is also valid. Correct the short tip as well as the extended explanation.
Both clubs and clubes are accepted.
Retain buen. Qualify the rule for de constructions and optional shortening with coordinated adjectives.
Retain mal before masculine singular nouns.
Retain gran; existing coordination/muy exceptions and más/menos restriction agree with DPD.
The monarch sense explicitly pairs rey with reina. Plurals follow DPD plural rules.
Don/doña are paired titles before first names. The gift/talent entry is separate; the table is scoped to the title.
The clerical secretary entry explicitly illustrates secretaria. DLE fetch failed; DEM entry text was readable despite an unrelated embedded 429 error.

nounSpecialCases.decision: retain original common-gender forms; reject uncorroborated addition
nounSpecialCases.finding: The entry marks dirigente as masculine and feminine. Dirigenta/dirigentas remain absent from the teaching table; insufficient corroboration is not a claim that they are incorrect.

pluralRuleScope: Unstressed vowel plurals add s; consonant and z plurals follow the specified es and spelling rules; rey/reyes is explicit. Rules corroborate derived plurals rather than pretending every plural has a separate dictionary entry.
implementationReview: Reviewed every production-code diff: explicit override tables, shared form parsing, NFC lookup and shared context-builder parser. No broader answer acceptance is introduced.

Compared all generated contexts to git HEAD: sentence texts, translations, targets and accepted answers unchanged. Only nine word gloss instances changed: científica, ciertas and media in three shared contexts each; grammatical-help changes are reviewed alongside their source notes.
failedRequests: RAE DPD rey and don are absent entries, not corroboration. DLE rey and don succeeded.
DLE secretario failed; lower-case DEM /ver/secretario succeeded.
Research subagent: DLE candidato/candidata failed; candidate evidence comes from DEM plus Parliament of Canarias glossary.

functionWordReview.scope: All 61 audit entries, 30 added tables, eight demonstrative/possessive families, changed usage explanations and first-set overlays. No added form required rollback.

wordingCorrection.finding: Pre-existing subject-only tip was too narrow: a local direct object can also be the antecedent. Replaced subject with third-person referent in the same sentence.

limits: Tables are sense-scoped; adverbial cuán and tan are not additions to the quantity-pronoun paradigms.
Do not infer that demonstratives can never take an accent from older UOC guidance. No such claim was added.
Ordinal apocopation notes summarize the ordinary rule; certain coordinated/elliptical constructions permit a full form.

contextGlossSources.finding: In investigación científica the adjective describes research, not a female scientist.
Before familias, the indefinite certain/some sense applies.
Clase media is the social middle class, not half a class.

regularNounReview.scope: All 46 ordinary added noun counterparts checked against actual current gloss and authored sentence; all retained. Feminine plurals derived from RAE plural rules.

senseChecks: política: woman politician, separately from politics/policy.
científica: scientist noun versus scientific adjective in investigación científica.
española: person nationality, not the language; tip now distinguishes the senses.
perra: female dog; unrelated derogatory uses do not invalidate the animal sense.

singularScopeReview.decision: retain existing runtime scope with more precise explanation
findings: Fútbol, pasado and izquierda tables were already singular-only at HEAD. Added exceptions explain that scope.
Música generated data previously contained músicas, but the authored runtime overlay already suppressed its table. Current generated data aligns with that overlay.
These are sense-scoped singular tables, not universal plural bans or claims that every entry is inherently uncountable.
Izquierdas also occurs in nonpolitical fixed expressions; explanation corrected.

validation.assessment: All 1500 full assessment records equal Git HEAD, including sentence chunks.
validation.tests: All 344 tests pass; npm run check and git diff --check pass.
validation.linguisticConfidence: Retained changes have explicit lexical, paradigm or rule support; this is not proof of absolute correctness in every dialect or sense.
validation.browser: Local miembro preview shows corrected short tip and expanded explanation.
